name: Mohanlal
role: Key Officer Loyal to Siraj ud-Daulah
contribution: He remained one of the most active loyalists in Siraj's camp and continued fighting when others hesitated.
context: Plassey battlefield decisions and loyalist resistance.
impact: He symbolizes the faction within the Nawab's camp that resisted capitulation.
highlight: Mohanlal was one of Siraj ud-Daulah's principal loyalist commanders during the Battle of Plassey.
seoTitle: Mohanlal: Siraj ud-Daulah's Loyalist at Plassey
seoDescription: Learn about Mohanlal's loyalist role in Siraj ud-Daulah's camp and the military decisions at the 1757 Battle of Plassey.
shortAnswer: Mohanlal was a senior loyalist officer in Siraj ud-Daulah's camp who continued resisting at the Battle of Plassey.
